Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: partial.

The data model and tests support optional display_kind and image_file inventory columns, including real-backend fixture input, but the follow-up says the import wizard has no corresponding binding UI. This is partial schema capability, not an end-to-end wizard completion. Add both controls to the wizard/column mapping view, persist the chosen mapping, and prove it reaches AssetRegistry.fromInventory through a fixture import.

Evidence:
- studio/app/src/test/scala/eyes4s/studio/app/importing/ColumnMappingPaneSuite.scala:70
- studio/core/.jvm/src/test/scala/eyes4s/studio/core/real/RealStudyBackendSuite.scala:113
- io/src/test/scala/eyes4s/io/StudioAcceptanceSuite.scala:66

Remaining / next action: Expose and persist both mappings in the wizard and test AssetRegistry end-to-end.

Disposition: Keep open.
